Define gen3sis richness color scale for non colour-vision deficient

Source: R/plotting_functions.R
color_richness_CVDCBP.Rd

Define gen3sis richness color scale for non colour-vision deficient

Usage

color_richness_CVDCBP(n)

Arguments

n

corresponds to the colorRampPalette parameter

Value

returns a colorRampPalette function with the gen3sis richness colors
